When the Pokémon poisons a target, it also becomes confused.
When the Pokémon enters a battle, it transforms into its Terastal Form.
While the Pokémon's HP is full, moves that deal damage to it are not very effective.
When Terapagos changes to its Stellar Form, it eliminates the effects of all weather and terrain.
